ref.description: Reuse an item declared in another file or course.

examples.description: Examples belong to the course whose file declares them; other courses fall back to them.

id.description: Unique within its item, e.g. "q1" or "scenario-archive".

type.description: single: one correct option · multi: several correct · true_false: uses `answer` · typing: uses `answers` · cloze: blanks in `prompt` with {{c1::answer}} · order: `options` listed in the correct order · match: each option has `match` · flashcard: uses `back`

facet.description: Which side of the item this question trains. Default: "apply" (vocab: "use").

prompt.description: The question (markdown). For cloze, the sentence with {{c1::answer}} blanks.

correct.description: Mark the correct option(s) here — never by index.

why.description: Why this option is right or wrong; shown after answering.

match.description: match questions only: the right-hand side paired with this option.

back.description: flashcard only: the back of the card (markdown).
